title: Critical Interval MSE: Toward Reliable Offline Validation for Robot Manipulation Policies
abstract: arXiv:2606.29898v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Real-world evaluation is the gold standard for robot manipulation policies because it tests them against the physical conditions and deployment challenges they are ultimately designed to handle. However, real-world evaluation is also the bottleneck for iterating on robot imitation learning policies: it is costly, difficult to reproduce, and often too sparse to reliably compare nearby model variants. A straightforward proxy for performance is validation loss on expert demonstrations, but this proxy is often poorly correlated with real-world performance. In this paper, we introduce Critical Interval MSE (CI-MSE), an intuitively simple yet effective offline validation metric. CI-MSE uses a zero-shot agent to localize task-critical segments, restricts error computation to those segments, and applies simple action-alignment procedures that better match rollout-time behavior. translated_title: 关键区间均方误差：迈向可靠的机器人操作策略离线验证
translated_abstract: 真实世界评估是机器人操作策略的黄金标准，因为它能够针对策略最终要应对的物理条件和部署挑战对其进行测试。然而，真实世界评估也是迭代改进机器人模仿学习策略的瓶颈：其成本高昂、难以复现，且通常过于稀疏，无法可靠地比较相近的模型变体。一种直接的替代性能指标是专家演示上的验证损失，但该指标往往与真实世界性能的相关性很差。在本文中，我们提出了关键区间均方误差（CI-MSE），这是一种直观简单却有效的离线验证指标。CI-MSE 利用零样本智能体定位任务关键片段，将误差计算限制在这些片段上，并采用简单的动作对齐程序以更好地匹配实际部署时的行为。在仿真和真实世界实验中，CI-MSE 通常能够……
tldr: 本文提出CI-MSE这一离线验证指标，通过零样本智能体定位任务关键片段并仅在这些片段上计算对齐误差，从而实现对机器人操作策略真实世界性能的可靠离线预测。
